definition_primary: ensemble_exists(set,poem,verse) = True iff >=2 of {anthropic,openai,google} returned exists=True for that cell (2-of-3 majority; see module docstring for the unparseable-cell rule)
span_rule_secondary: a GT span counts as matched (1 ensemble TP) iff >=2 of the models that voted exists=True independently best_match() it to the SAME GT span index under the strict/token criterion; otherwise the verse counts as 1 FP + FN per GT span. LIMITATION: under-counts TP when 2+ 'yes' models each correctly identify a DIFFERENT real span (see module docstring).

errors_unparseable.rule: none needed -- 0 occurred across all 5886 model cells
